title: FactoryLock
$comment: Generated by `pnpm build` in contracts/ from typespec/. Do not edit.

version.description: The version of the lock's format.

unevaluatedProperties.description: One registry MCP server at its exact version, with the npm package or the remote it starts.

mcp.description: The registry MCP servers, by their reference in factory.yaml, for example `registry:io.github.acme/tracker@1.4`.

range.description: The range under `providers` that the pin was resolved from, for example "^2".

unevaluatedProperties.description: One adapter's npm package `@opensoftware/<port>-<name>` at the newest version inside its range.

adapters.description:
The adapters under `providers` that `factory plan --adapters` pinned, per port and adapter name (ADR 0125). A pin
counts only while its `range` is the range factory.yaml declares.

source.description: The entry of `skills` in factory.yaml that the pin was resolved from, `git+<url>#<ref>:<path>`.

commit.description: The full commit, 40 hexadecimal characters, or 64 in a repository of SHA-256.

hash.description: The hash of the skill folder's files in the form of Go's modules: "h1:" and the base64 of a SHA-256.

unevaluatedProperties.description: One skill of another Git repository at the commit its ref had when `factory plan` pinned it.

skills.description:
The skills of other Git repositories that `factory plan` pinned, by the skill's name (ADR 0146). A pin counts only
while its `source` is the entry factory.yaml declares; the foreman and `factory render` fetch its commit and check
its hash.

description:
factory.lock next to factory.yaml (ADR 0020, ADR 0125): the exact versions that `factory plan` pinned. factory-spec
writes it; the foreman reads the pins of its adapters.
